items.html: You should also understand how, even within a single Partzuf alone, Mochin descend from one Sefira to another — but only from Keter to Chochma, from Chochma to Bina, from Bina to Tifferet, and from Tifferet to Malchut — and all this within the Partzuf itself. And similarly from this Partzuf to another Partzuf.
